name: offset-com-best
$comment: Carton 1.5 kg, CoM offset (60, 30) mm, gripped over the CoM: the fastest trajectory of design/optimize.py, family 4 (joint, blended), T_cyc 1.626 s at a holding margin of 0.50 (required 0.5) and 55 % of the robot limits.

annotations.text: Kinematic arm: the LR-10iA/10 follows the planned joint trajectory exactly (no arm dynamics). PickPlanner checks the datasheet limits (util_*); ToolMotion prescribes the gripper frame's twist.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Trajectory family: 1 joint PTP with stops, 2 Cartesian with stops, 3 Cartesian blended, 4 joint blended

parameters.name: kv
parameters.description: Joint moves: share of the datasheet joint rate limits

parameters.name: ka
parameters.description: Joint moves: share of the joint acceleration and jerk limits

parameters.name: lam
parameters.description: Jerk phase as a share of each acceleration phase (0 trapezoid, 1 pure S-curve)

parameters.name: r_b
parameters.description: Blend distance (families 3, 4): the transfer starts when the lift has r_b to go

parameters.name: H_lift
parameters.description: Robot lift above the pick contact pose (and lowering at the place)

parameters.name: h_app
parameters.description: Approach height above the pick contact pose

parameters.name: h_dep
parameters.description: Depart height above the place contact pose

parameters.name: t_ext
parameters.description: Cylinder extension starts this long before the pick contact

parameters.name: t_vac
parameters.description: Vacuum on this long before the pick contact

parameters.name: T_seal
parameters.description: Wait at the pick for the vacuum to build

parameters.name: ret_hold
parameters.description: Retract the cylinders while holding (1) or keep them extended (0)

parameters.name: t_ret
parameters.description: Retract this long after the lift start (ret_hold = 1)

parameters.name: t_ext2
parameters.description: Extend again this long before the place contact (ret_hold = 1)

parameters.name: T_rel
parameters.description: Wait at the place after the vacuum is switched off

parameters.name: d_press
parameters.description: Bellows press at the pick contact pose

parameters.name: M_req
parameters.description: Required holding margin 1 - U (0.5 = safety factor 2)

parameters.name: tilt_gain
parameters.description: Waiter motion: share of the tilt that turns the cup axis into the specific force a - g of the load (0 off, 1 full)

parameters.name: tilt_max_deg
parameters.description: Waiter motion: largest tool tilt (smooth saturation)

parameters.name: T_tw
parameters.description: Waiter motion: the planned load acceleration is averaged over a triangle window of +-T_tw (smooth wrist motion)

parameters.name: T_tr
parameters.description: Waiter motion: the tilt fades in over T_tr after the lift start and out over T_tr before the place contact

parameters.name: f5_Tl
parameters.description: Family 5: lift duration (H_lift, from the lift start)

parameters.name: f5_Td
parameters.description: Family 5: lower duration (H_lift, ending at the place contact)

parameters.name: f5_Tx
parameters.description: Family 5: transfer duration (straight line, own profile)

parameters.name: f5_ox
parameters.description: Family 5: transfer start after the lift start

parameters.name: f5_ex
parameters.description: Family 5: carry time after the transfer end (the lower finishes)

parameters.name: f5_ax
parameters.description: Family 5: acceleration phase of the transfer, share of its duration

parameters.name: f5_dx
parameters.description: Family 5: deceleration phase of the transfer, share of its duration

parameters.name: f5_y0
parameters.description: Family 5: the yaw turn starts at this share of the carry

parameters.name: f5_y1
parameters.description: Family 5: the yaw turn ends at this share of the carry

parameters.name: z_s
parameters.description: Support surface (conveyor and place table) above the robot base

parameters.name: psig_deg
parameters.description: Gripper yaw relative to the parcel

parameters.name: gx
parameters.description: Grip point (gripper centre) in the parcel frame, x

parameters.name: gy
parameters.description: Grip point in the parcel frame, y

parameters.name: e_m
parameters.description: Edge margin of an active cup (its lip inside the top face)

parameters.name: m_p
parameters.description: Parcel mass (the plain carton; shell + content in the loose-content models)

parameters.name: cx
parameters.description: Centre of mass offset from the box centre, x (parcel frame)

parameters.name: Jpx
parameters.description: Parcel inertia about its x axis (uniform box)

parameters.name: h_base
parameters.description: Flange to the cylinder mounting face

parameters.name: m_base
parameters.description: Adapter plate, valve block and fittings

parameters.name: rod0
parameters.description: Rod length out of the body when retracted (to the cup mount)

parameters.name: m_rod
parameters.description: Moving mass of a zone: rod, cup holder and cup

parameters.name: r_p
parameters.description: Pitch radius of the four outer cylinders

parameters.name: lay_deg
parameters.description: Rotation of the outer four cylinders (0 '+', 45 'x')

parameters.name: kt_rod
parameters.description: Lateral stiffness of a rod in its guide

parameters.name: bt_rod
parameters.description: Lateral damping of a rod (damping ratio 0.3)

parameters.name: kr_rod
parameters.description: Bending stiffness of a rod in its guide

parameters.name: br_rod
parameters.description: Bending damping of a rod (damping ratio 0.3)

parameters.name: q_r0
parameters.description: Rod start position: pressed into the retract stop

parameters.name: F_min
parameters.description: Residual friction capacity of a free lip

parameters.name: s_bot
parameters.description: Cup compression stroke before the folds bottom (estimate)

parameters.name: x_bot
parameters.description: Reference over-stroke of the bottoming law

parameters.name: A_fold
parameters.description: Folded bellows annulus: vacuum lift stroke A_fold*dp/k_ax (estimate)

parameters.name: c_vac
parameters.description: Cup lateral/tilt stiffness rise with vacuum, 1 + c_vac*dp/p_atm (estimate)

parameters.name: c_ext
parameters.description: Cup lateral/tilt stiffness fall with extension, exp(-c_ext*ext/L0) (estimate)

parameters.name: h_stack
parameters.value: h_base + L_cyl + rod0 + stroke + L0 - d_press
parameters.description: Flange to the pressed cup lip with the cylinders extended

parameters.name: Q_max
parameters.description: Ejector suction flow at zero vacuum (free air, per zone)

parameters.name: zc_g
parameters.description: Gripper centre of mass below the flange (cylinders extended)

parameters.name: Jg45
parameters.value: m_base*(h_base/2 - zc_g)^2 + 5*m_cyl*((h_base + L_cyl/2 - zc_g)^2 + L_cyl^2/12) + 5*m_rod*(h_base + L_cyl + rod0 + stroke - zc_g)^2 + 2*(m_cyl + m_rod)*r_p^2
parameters.description: Gripper inertia about a horizontal axis through its centre of mass (point-mass estimate)

parameters.name: Jg6
parameters.description: Gripper inertia about the tool axis (point-mass estimate)

parameters.name: M45_max
parameters.description: LR-10iA/10 allowable load moment at the wrist, J4 and J5

parameters.name: M6_max
parameters.description: LR-10iA/10 allowable load moment at the wrist, J6

parameters.name: I45_max
parameters.description: LR-10iA/10 allowable load inertia at the wrist, J4 and J5

parameters.name: I6_max
parameters.description: LR-10iA/10 allowable load inertia at the wrist, J6

parameters.name: qddmax1
parameters.description: J1 acceleration limit (assumed: the rate limit in 0.15 s)

parameters.name: qddmax2
parameters.description: J2 acceleration limit (assumed: the rate limit in 0.15 s)

parameters.name: qddmax3
parameters.description: J3 acceleration limit (assumed: the rate limit in 0.15 s)

parameters.name: qddmax4
parameters.description: J4 acceleration limit (assumed: the rate limit in 0.10 s)

parameters.name: qddmax5
parameters.description: J5 acceleration limit (assumed: the rate limit in 0.10 s)

parameters.name: qddmax6
parameters.description: J6 acceleration limit (assumed: the rate limit in 0.10 s)

parameters.name: qdddmax1
parameters.description: J1 jerk limit (assumed: the acceleration limit in 0.05 s)

parameters.name: qdddmax2
parameters.description: J2 jerk limit (assumed: the acceleration limit in 0.05 s)

parameters.name: qdddmax3
parameters.description: J3 jerk limit (assumed: the acceleration limit in 0.05 s)

parameters.name: qdddmax4
parameters.description: J4 jerk limit (assumed: the acceleration limit in 0.05 s)

parameters.name: qdddmax5
parameters.description: J5 jerk limit (assumed: the acceleration limit in 0.05 s)

parameters.name: qdddmax6
parameters.description: J6 jerk limit (assumed: the acceleration limit in 0.05 s)

parameters.name: zA
parameters.description: Gripper (flange) height at the approach start

parameters.name: pen0
parameters.description: Rest penetration of the parcel corners in the support

parameters.name: rz0
parameters.description: Cup lip to parcel top at the start, cylinders retracted (cup frame z)
